migrations.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sources (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, user_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Other', url TEXT, notes TEXT, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sources_user_name ON sources (user_id, name COLLATE NOCASE); ALTER TABLE leads ADD COLUMN source_id TEXT; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_leads_source ON leads (source_id); INSERT INTO sources (id, user_id, name, kind, created_at) SELECT lower(hex(randomblob(16))), user_id, MIN(n), MIN(k), MIN(created_at) FROM (SELECT user_id, created_at, CASE WHEN trim(source) LIKE 'Facebook groups: %' THEN trim(substr(trim(source), 18)) WHEN trim(source) LIKE 'Facebook group: %' THEN trim(substr(trim(source), 17)) ELSE trim(source) END AS n, CASE WHEN trim(source) LIKE 'Facebook group%' THEN 'Facebook group' ELSE 'Other' END AS k FROM leads WHERE source IS NOT NULL AND trim(source) <> '') GROUP BY user_id, n COLLATE NOCASE
